answer: Operator-Linked Reputation Spiral. Each wallet inherits a reputation score from its operator's verified fiscal history, mapped as a violet trace across shared settlement ledgers. A sybil cluster cannot mirror the operator's transaction graph without incurring the same tax exposure and audit liability per wallet. New wallets enter at a low spiral rating, and each identity the operator provisions raises their audit rate and compliance cost, so mass provisioning becomes economically punishing at the operator level.
